title: Immediate Steps After a Car Accident in Indianapolis, Indiana
metaDescription: Learn the essential immediate steps to take after a car accident in Indianapolis, IN, including safety measures and reporting protocols.
excerpt: Educational Indianapolis, IN guide — 2-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on I-95 or surface streets in Indianapolis can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.
Call 911 when anyone reports pain, airbags deploy, fluids leak, or traffic is blocked. Indianapolis County dispatch will route Indianapolis police or state patrol depending on location.
list: Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts on if traffic passes closely at highway speed
Do not admit fault — describe facts only
Request a crash report number before officers leave

sections.heading: Indianapolis documentation checklist
paragraphs: Photograph all vehicles, license plates, VIN stickers, skid marks, traffic signals, and visible injuries. Indianapolis insurers expect timestamped photos.
Collect names and phone numbers from witnesses — independent accounts matter on I-95, I-75, US-1 and in Indianapolis County.
Exchange insurance policy numbers and registration; note employer if the other driver was working.

sections.heading: Medical care within 24 hours
paragraphs: Indianapolis has Indianapolis Regional Medical Center and Indianapolis General Hospital among its major facilities. Level I trauma care is available at Indianapolis Level I Trauma Center.
Whiplash, concussion, and internal injuries may appear hours later. A same-day urgent care or ER visit creates a medical record insurers cannot easily dismiss.

sections.heading: Indiana reporting rules
paragraphs: Indiana requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 25/50/25.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://www.in.gov/indot/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
Indiana uses 51% bar comparative negligence; anything you say can affect fault allocation.

sections.heading: Evidence preservation in Indianapolis
paragraphs: Dashcam, Ring doorbell, and business security footage near Indianapolis downtown interchange is often deleted within 7–30 days. Send written preservation letters when appropriate.
Save repair estimates, rental receipts, and mileage to medical appointments.

sections.heading: When to explore attorney matching
paragraphs: Consider a free consultation if you were hospitalized, fault is disputed, a commercial vehicle was involved, or the adjuster offers a quick settlement before treatment finishes.
WreckMatch LLC connects Indianapolis residents with licensed Indiana attorneys — we are a referral service, not a law firm.

sections.heading: Indianapolis medical resources after a crash
paragraphs: Indianapolis residents often use Indianapolis Regional Medical Center, Indianapolis General Hospital after serious collisions. Level I trauma care is available at Indianapolis Level I Trauma Center.
Document every provider visit — gaps in treatment are a common reason IN insurers reduce settlement offers.
Keep receipts for prescriptions, imaging (MRI/CT), physical therapy, and medical transport.
list: Photograph visible injuries the same day when safe
Follow discharge instructions and keep all after-visit summaries
Do not sign blanket medical authorizations for the adjuster

sections.heading: Local crash patterns: I-95, I-75, US-1
paragraphs: The metro area sees roughly 10,725 reported crashes annually (est.). High-risk areas include Indianapolis downtown interchange; Major highway corridor near Indianapolis.
If your collision occurred near I-95, note mile markers, exit numbers, and direction of travel for the police report.
Indiana DOT data is available via https://www.in.gov/indot/ — useful when disputing fault or road conditions.

paragraphs: Request the official crash report through the investigating agency. Indianapolis County Civil Court handles many civil injury filings in the region.
Business security video near Indianapolis retail corridors is often deleted within 7–30 days — send preservation letters quickly when appropriate.

sections.heading: Settlement timeline expectations in Indianapolis
paragraphs: Minor property-damage claims in Indianapolis may resolve in weeks, but injury claims involving treatment, lost wages, or disputed fault often take months. Insurers may request recorded statements, independent medical exams, and broad medical authorizations — review each request carefully.
Indiana uses 51% bar comparative negligence with a 2-year statute of limitations for most injury cases. Calendar your deadline from the date of injury.

If you were transported from I-95 to Indianapolis Regional Medical Center, keep ambulance, ER, and follow-up bills organized. UM/UIM and MedPay endorsements may apply when the other driver is underinsured.
list: Do not accept the first settlement check if treatment is ongoing
Avoid discussing fault on social media
Request adjuster denials or reservations of rights in writing
Compare repair estimates with your insurer's appraisal
Consult a licensed attorney before signing general releases

sections.heading: Document checklist for Indianapolis claims
paragraphs: Organize a folder (physical or digital) for every document tied to your Indianapolis crash: police report number, insurance claim numbers, tow and storage receipts, and rental car agreements.
Request itemized medical bills from Indianapolis Regional Medical Center rather than summary statements — itemized bills help catch billing errors and support future negotiations.
list: Photos of all vehicles and the scene from multiple angles
Employer note for any missed work shifts
Insurance adjuster name, phone, and claim number
Repair estimates from at least two body shops
